entities.summary: Svetlana Loboda (b. 1982-10-18, Irpin) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Irpin and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
